title: Hosts
hint: Which themes and scripts each proxy host gets.
intro: Every proxy host in Nginx Proxy Manager gets the same block (with $host). Which themes and scripts a host gets is set here. Hosts without their own row follow Default (*). Changes are live within a minute.
snippetIntro: Paste this block under Advanced (Custom Nginx Configuration) of every proxy host, on its own at server level: never inside a location / (that replaces NPM's own location, and with it the Access List). It is the same everywhere; you never need to change it. Replace your old sub_filter, sub_filter_once and Accept-Encoding lines with it: sub_filter_once twice makes nginx -t fail and takes the host offline.
snippetLabel: Block for Advanced of every proxy host
optionsError: The rule and choices could not be loaded
ownDomainSummary: Apps whose CSP refuses the CSS domain (Nextcloud, Vaultwarden…)
ownDomainText: Use this block there instead of the regular one: the theme then comes through /alg-thema/ on the app's own domain. The location only forwards GET and HEAD, without cookies or Authorization. CSS only: that way no cssthema script ever ends up in a password vault.
ownDomainLabel: Block via the own domain, CSS only
loadError: The hosts could not be loaded
emptyText: Set up the default first, or import your existing NPM config.
defaultMissingText: Hosts without their own row currently get nothing. Set a default (*) for all other hosts.
deleteDefaultText: Hosts without their own row will then get nothing.
dialogDescription: Themes load in this order: a later one overrides an earlier one.
hostnameHint: E.g. proxmox.yourdomain.com, or * for every host without its own row.
stylesHint: Published themes and CSS files; you may also type another name.
scriptsHint: Empty for apps where no script may run (e.g. a password vault).
unknownHint: Not among the published themes and files.
fieldEnabled: On (off: the host gets nothing, not even the default)
errorHostConflict: That hostname already has a binding.
importDescription: Paste the contents of themes/hosts-modules.conf or npm-sub_filter-per-dienst.conf: a # hostname line above each sub_filter line, or # * for every host without its own binding.
checkIntro: Check all opens, like a browser, every host with its own binding and every imported service that follows the default (*). It checks whether the rule is in the page and whether the app's CSP allows the CSS domain. Hosts behind Authentik show as “behind login”; an own binding that has not loaded for 14 days gets “never (recently) loaded”. The check also runs daily at 06:15.
healthError: The status of the hosts could not be loaded.
unboundText: These hosts loaded the rule or were imported as a service, but have no row of their own: they get the default (*). Services are checked too.
snippetWhy: sub_filter only reads uncompressed HTML. The more_set_input_headers lines clear Accept-Encoding for HTML pages; the app's scripts and CSS stay compressed. proxy_set_header Accept-Encoding does not work in Advanced: NPM's location / sets its own proxy_set_header lines and then does not inherit it.
neverText: Do not put the block in the proxy host of the dashboard (DASHBOARD_HOST) or of the CSS domain, nor in the one for Authentik or the NPM admin page: add those to EXCLUDED_HOSTS. These hosts never get anything, not even with a binding. Give apps with their own moving background (e.g. allow and aiverslag) a binding that is switched off.
ownDomainScriptSummary: With script, for apps that only refuse scripts from another domain (Portainer, qBittorrent, Pi-hole)
ownDomainScriptWarning: Through the own domain the script runs as the app itself: its CSP no longer stops it and it sees everything you see and type in the app. Do not use this block for Vaultwarden, Authentik or other sensitive apps.
ownDomainScriptLabel: Block via the own domain, with script
staleLine: Not loaded for 14 days (or never): is the block in this proxy host?
excludedLine: Never gets anything: dashboard, CSS domain or EXCLUDED_HOSTS.
encodingLine: The app sends its HTML compressed ({encoding})
bulkDescription: One change for many hosts at once, e.g. add a colour variant everywhere. Hosts that never get anything are skipped.
